videos.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
videos.overview: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
videos.overview: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
videos.overview: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
videos.overview: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
videos.overview: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
videos.overview: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
videos.overview: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
videos.overview: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
videos.overview: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
videos.overview: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
videos.overview: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
videos.overview: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
videos.overview: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
videos.overview: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
videos.overview: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
videos.overview: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
videos.overview: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
videos.overview: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
videos.overview: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
videos.overview: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
videos.overview: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
videos.overview: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
videos.overview: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
videos.overview: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
videos.overview: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
videos.overview: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
videos.overview: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
videos.overview: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
videos.overview: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
videos.overview: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
videos.overview: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
videos.overview: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
videos.overview: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
videos.overview: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
videos.overview: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
videos.overview: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
videos.overview: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
videos.overview: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
videos.overview: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

videos.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
videos.overview: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!
